title: Uppercase and Lowercase Converter
description: Convert text to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, and capitalization in the browser without sending text to the server.
metaTitle: Free online uppercase and lowercase converter
metaDescription: Convert text to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, and capitalization in the browser without sending content to the server.

form.title: Convert capitalization
form.description: Paste text, choose a mode, and copy the result generated in the browser.

input.title: Original text
input.label: Text to convert
input.placeholder: Type or paste your text here.
input.privacy: Conversion happens in your browser. This tool does not send text to the server.

options.title: Conversion mode
options.description: Choose how letters should be transformed.

modeDescriptions.maiusculas: Converts letters to uppercase and preserves numbers, punctuation, spaces, and emoji.
modeDescriptions.minusculas: Converts letters to lowercase and preserves numbers, punctuation, spaces, and emoji.
modeDescriptions.frase: Uppercases the first letter of sentences and lines after lowercasing the rest.
modeDescriptions.titulo: Capitalizes main words and keeps short connector words lowercase when possible.
modeDescriptions.capitalizar-palavras: Uppercases the first letter of every word.
modeDescriptions.alternado: Alternates uppercase and lowercase across letters only.
modeDescriptions.inverter: Swaps uppercase letters to lowercase and lowercase letters to uppercase.

preserveLineBreaks.label: Preserve line breaks
preserveLineBreaks.description: When disabled, line breaks become spaces before conversion.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only the mode and safe options.
share.includeContent: Include text in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include pasted or typed text.
share.publicWarning: Links with text expose the content to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The text is too large for a safe link. The link will include only options.

result.title: Result
result.description: The original stays separate so you can review before copying or downloading.
result.emptyDescription: Paste text to generate the conversion.
result.convertedDescription: Applied mode: {mode}. Review names, acronyms, brands, and formal text before publishing.
result.tooLargeDescription: The text exceeds the {limit}-character limit. Reduce it to avoid browser freezes.

warnings.titleCaseApproximation: Title case is a practical heuristic, not a formal editorial rule.
warnings.largeInput: Input is above the safety limit.
warnings.noLetterChanges: No letters changed with this mode.

privacy.question: Is the text sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Conversion happens in the browser. Text only enters the link if you enable the option to include text when sharing.

differences.question: What is the difference between sentence, title, and capitalize words?
differences.answer: Sentence capitalizes sentence starts. Title tries to handle short connector words. Capitalize words changes the start of every word.

accents.question: Does the tool handle accents and emoji?
accents.answer: Yes. Conversion uses browser language features and preserves punctuation, numbers, spaces, and emoji.

variation.question: Why can the result differ from a text editor?
variation.answer: Each editor may apply its own rules for names, acronyms, brands, and styles. This tool uses a simple deterministic rule.

sharing.question: Can I share already filled text?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only after enabling the option to include text in the link. Use that only when recipients are allowed to read the content.

noAccents.question: Does this remove accents or create slugs?
noAccents.answer: No. This tool changes capitalization. Accent removal, text cleanup, and slug creation are separate transformations.

seo.aboutTitle: About the uppercase and lowercase converter
seo.about: The converter transforms text in the browser to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, per-word capitalization, alternating case, or inverted case. It preserves the original text and shows character and byte metrics for review.
seo.howToUse: Type or paste text, choose the conversion mode, and copy, download, or use the result as new input. Shared links preserve only safe options by default; include text in the link only if it can be public.
